Class TeachingTip

java.lang.Object
net.tessel.fx.components.TeachingTip
public class TeachingTip extends Object
A popover with a tail that points at a control, to explain a feature. 
TeachingTip tip = new TeachingTip("Save your work", "Press Ctrl+S at any time.");
tip.setActionButton("Got it", () -> markTipSeen());
tip.show(saveButton);
The tip is drawn inside the window, follows its target when the window is resized or scrolled, and closes on Esc or on a click elsewhere (see setLightDismiss(boolean)).
